errors.render: The edit could not be made from this video. Nothing changed: try other settings.
errors.internal: Something went wrong while making the edit. Nothing changed: try again.

editor.leaveHint: No need to wait on this page: you can leave it or close the tab, the edit finishes without you. A notification comes when it is ready.
editor.leaveHintForeign: No need to wait on this page: you can leave it or close the tab, the edit finishes without you.
editor.keys: Space plays and pauses · ← → move by a second, with Shift by a tenth · Delete removes what is picked
editor.leaveText: The changes made here will be lost.
editor.copyDone: The copy is ready: it is on your shelf.
editor.done: The edit is ready: everyone sees it now.
editor.failed: The edit could not be made.
editor.cropHint: Drag the frame or its corners on the picture. A horizontal video can become vertical or square.
editor.cutsHint: Remove pieces from the middle: the rest is joined smoothly.
editor.blurHint: Hide part of the picture for a while.
editor.timerHint: A stopwatch from 0:00 between two moments; it stays {{hold}} s after the end, then goes.
editor.captionHint: Text on the picture between two moments.
editor.normalizeHint: Quiet parts louder, loud ones quieter. Applied when saving.

dialog.skipped: Left out: {count, plural, one {# video} other {# videos}} — bookmarks and unfinished videos can’t be sent by link.
dialog.emailHint: We’ll email them the link. It opens only with a code sent to this address.
dialog.passwordOnce: Keep the password: it won’t be shown again.
dialog.generatedCopied: New password copied to the clipboard.

gate.title: Protected link · {count, plural, one {# video} other {# videos}}
gate.codeLead: This link is for {{email}}. We’ll send a code to that address.
gate.account: Have an account with this email?

mine.title: My links
mine.lead: Temporary links that still work. A revoked or expired link no longer opens; what people added to their shelves stays with them.
mine.empty: No links that still work. Pick videos on your shelf and choose “Temporary link”.

anonymous.title: Anonymous links to your shelf
anonymous.lead: Share your shelf without showing your nickname. Whoever opens such a link sees your videos as any visitor does and can exchange with you, but never learns your nickname or the address of your page. A deleted link stops opening.
anonymous.name: Name shown through the link
anonymous.nameHint: Only you see the note. Without a name of its own, the link shows your name.
anonymous.nameNeededHint: Only you see the note. Your name gives away your nickname, so the link needs a name of its own.
anonymous.deleteText: It stops opening at once. Exchanges started through it go on, and those who received your videos keep seeing you by this link's name.

deals.linkNotCopied: The link is made but could not be copied: find it in “My links”.

mine.title: Links for an exchange
mine.lead: Whoever opens one starts their own deal with you, a guest too. They work until you take them back.
mine.deals: {count, plural, =0 {no deals yet} one {# deal} other {# deals}}
mine.revokeText: It stops opening at once. Deals already started from it go on.

fair.title: A fair exchange
fair.lead: Videos change hands both ways at once — or not at all.
fair.kept: Your video is uploaded to {{site}} and kept locked: nobody can watch or download it.
fair.seen: The person you exchange with sees only what you see here about their video: its title, length, size, quality and frame preview.
fair.both: If you both agree, the exchange happens at once: you get their video, they get yours. Nobody can take without giving.
fair.deleted: If the deal is declined, cancelled or runs out, your video is deleted from our servers right away — nobody ever sees it.
fair.guest: The deal waits three days for an answer; every new step by either side gives it three more. No account needed.

video.offerHint: No account needed: upload your own video in return.

thread.expires: A deal with a guest: it runs out {{date}} unless someone makes a new offer.

trade.dealGone: This deal does not open in this browser. Open it with the link from your email or the one you copied.
trade.linkGone: This exchange is no longer offered.
trade.accessOver: The week to watch and download is over.
trade.nothingToGive: You have no videos to offer yet: upload some to your shelf first.
trade.nothingToRequest: You can already watch these videos, or you asked for them before.
trade.cancelText: Your videos are deleted from our servers right away.
trade.emailSaved: Saved: the deal’s link is in your inbox.
trade.dealCopied: Copied: this link opens the deal on any device.

connect.title: Connect the extension
connect.lead: The tapeshelf browser extension will be able to save videos to your shelf, and nothing else. You can disconnect it any time in Settings → Security.
connect.done: Connected. This window closes by itself.
connect.invalid: This connection link is incomplete. Start connecting from the extension.
connect.terms: By connecting, you confirm that you save videos from other sites only when you have the right to keep them.
